We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel.

Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.

But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.

Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.

Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital.

Your mission

Build the quality system that lets Tilla ship quickly and safely: reusable test automation, sound release judgement, and a way of working that makes quality everyone's job in practice. As our first dedicated QA engineer, you will take ownership of work currently shared across engineering, product, design and customer experience.

🧱 Reliable releases at pace / by architecting Tilla's test automation framework

  • Designing and building a scalable, reusable end-to-end test framework in Playwright and TypeScript

  • Automating coverage of critical user journeys across flight search, travel operations and tenant integrations

  • Owning the regression suite and keeping it fast, stable and trusted

  • Working with platform engineering to set risk-based thresholds for quality gates in CI

🚦 Protecting customer trust / by keeping critical defects out of production without slowing delivery

  • Triaging and prioritising defects by their impact on customers, including confusion as well as functional breakage, and deciding clearly what blocks a release and what does not.

  • Running release gates: critical journeys passing, feature flags validated, rollback confirmed

  • Own root cause analysis of bugs to find hotspots, and feeding what you learn back into tests and design, to build recurring fixes rather than mere patches.

  • Tracking incident count, defect rate and QA feedback latency, and acting on what they show

🧭 Quality as a shared practice / by embedding QA across the product lifecycle

  • Reviewing requirements early for testability, covering both functional and non-functional aspects

  • Defining test strategy and QA estimates during sprint grooming. Help define guidelines for default edge cases / workflows that need to be covered by engineering, design and product during grooming and hand-off.

  • Writing clear test documentation (test plans, test cases and coverage notes) that the wider team can rely on.

  • Asking the sharp questions that clarify requirements before they turn into defects

You should have

  • Experience: several years in QA engineering, including senior-level ownership of test strategy and automation within a product team

  • Experience: hands-on test automation with Playwright and TypeScript (essential)

Senior SDET

Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare? Do you take pride in building and maintaining robust test automation frameworks? Are you passionate about improving deployment processes for high-impact products?

Boxes ticked? If so, read on.

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software. Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

We are a passionate and driven team, lucky to unite under strong cultural drivers:
• Impact - We do work that matters.
• Collaboration – We are in it together.
• Human touch – We care deeply.

This role can be fully remote in the UK and EU (with occasional travel to our London office) within +/- 2 hours of the GMT time zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

What you will be doing

The Senior SDET, Frameworks role will lead the evolution of Semble’s test automation capability and help make quality a shared engineering discipline. You will:

• Lead the transformation towards a Quality Agent System, using AI agents and deterministic automation to continuously identify coverage gaps, generate and maintain tests, detect flaky tests, support exploratory testing, and surface reproducible defects.

• Design safe, maintainable agent workflows with clear responsibilities, isolated execution, human review, and appropriate controls. Agents should assist engineers and SDETs, not replace human judgement or merge their own changes.

• Establish the foundations required for this system, including a stable Playwright framework, reliable CI integration, ephemeral test environments, test data management, quality observability, and structured test knowledge.
• Set up meaningful quality gates in CI and PR workflows, including coverage validation, framework conventions, high-risk code checks, and actionable failure reporting.
• Rationalise our overcrowded E2E suite by identifying tests that belong at unit, API, or integration level, keeping E2E focused on critical user journeys.
• Build and maintain a cross-layer coverage map and risk-based defect view, helping teams understand where quality gaps exist and where automation investment will have the greatest impact.
• Expand test coverage and surface quality gaps earlier in the development lifecycle, including through test scenario generation, mutation testing, and AI-assisted exploratory testing.
• Conduct proof-of-concepts for non-functional testing, including performance, accessibility, security, and reliability testing.
• Contribute to company-wide quality strategy, tooling decisions, quality metrics, and shift-left adoption alongside the wider SDET and Engineering teams.
• Coach engineers and SDETs on effective test design, the testing pyramid, Playwright, and contributing to the shared framework.

What we are looking for

At a Senior level at Semble, we will expect you to be mostly autonomous in your scope and to own and solve complex tasks or lead projects independently. You will work with peers from different functions and have an impact across department. You may be in a mentoring role for more junior team members and should be able to influence effectively and lead by example throughout the company.
• 5+ years of professional experience as SDET or Test Automation Engineer
• A strong track record of designing, building, and evolving automation frameworks that are reliable, maintainable, and easy for engineers to adopt.
• Hands-on experience building AI-augmented or agentic quality workflows, not only using tools such as Cursor or Claude to generate test code.
• A pragmatic approach to AI adoption, with awareness of data privacy, security, clinical safety, cost, and false-positive risks.
• Strong commercial experience with TypeScript-based automation frameworks. Playwright experience is highly desirable.
• Experience with test coverage strategy and applying the testing pyramid to reduce unnecessary E2E testing.
• Experience with write unit, component, API and integration tests.
• Experience with performance testing tools, such as k6, is desirable.
• Knowledge of non-functional testing, including performance, accessibility, security, and reliability.
• Exposure to DevOps tools and cloud infrastructure, including Jenkins, Bitbucket, Datadog, and AWS.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to represent the SDET function, challenge assumptions, and defend quality in release discussions.
What you’ll get in return

About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of rental companies run their business on Rentman, and many of them depend on it talking smoothly to the rest of their stack: accounting packages, webshops, calendars, and our public API. When an integration breaks, invoices don’t sync, bookings go missing, and customers notice fast.

As Senior QA Specialist for the Integrations team, you make sure every release reaches those customers without regressions. You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows.

What you'll do

  • Join refinement with the Integrations team and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

  • Test new integrations and API changes end to end: our side, the partner’s side, and everything that can go wrong between them (auth, rate limits, partial syncs, retries, data mapping)

  • Explore beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

  • Build and maintain automated tests in TypeScript, with API and contract tests alongside Playwright E2E tests, and review the tests developers write in pull requests

  • Own the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions: triage failures the same day and fix flaky tests at the root cause, including ones caused by unreliable third-party sandboxes

  • Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan, and give a clear go / no-go call

  • Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what’s worth automating and what stays manual

  • Coach developers so they own their tests, and organise QA days with the other product teams

column1:
Aequilibrium is a Canadian digital transformation and software engineering company specializing in digital banking, financial services, customer experience, and emerging technologies. We partner with Canadian and US credit unions to modernize digital banking platforms, integrate enterprise systems, and deliver reliable, intuitive member experiences. We are expanding our QA engineering capability to support multiple Canadian credit union clients undergoing digital banking modernization, platform migrations, and integration initiatives.

The Opportunity

We are looking for experienced Senior QA Automation Engineers / Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs) who combine strong technical testing expertise with practical knowledge of banking and credit union operations. You will work with developers, business analysts, solution architects, product owners, and client teams to ensure complex digital banking applications are secure, reliable, accessible, and production-ready.

This is a hands-on engineering role. We are particularly interested in candidates who can design and maintain automated testing frameworks, validate end-to-end banking workflows, and test integrations between digital banking platforms and core banking systems.

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation &
• Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, and integration tests for web and mobile banking applications.
• Build reusable test automation frameworks and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
• Develop test strategies, test plans, scenarios, and traceability aligned with business requirements.
• Execute functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and exploratory testing.
• Investigate defects, analyze logs, identify root causes, and collaborate with developers to resolve them.
• Improve test coverage, automation reliability, and quality reporting.
Digital Banking &
• Validate member-facing journeys, including login, MFA, account balances, transfers, bill payments, Interac e-Transfer, mobile cheque deposit and account servicing.
• Test commercial banking capabilities such as delegated access, entitlements, approvals and business payments.
• Validate integrations between digital banking platforms, core banking systems, payment services, lending applications and CRM systems.
• Support data migration testing, reconciliation and regression testing during platform replacements.
• Participate in system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), release readiness and production validation.
• Collaborate with client business teams to ensure test scenarios reflect real banking operations and member needs.
Engineering &
• Work within Agile delivery teams and contribute to sprint planning, refinement and acceptance criteria.
• Integrate quality engineering practices into development workflows.
• Support performance, security, and accessibility testing in collaboration with specialists.
• Provide clear quality metrics, defect reporting, and release-readiness assessments.
• Help establish automated quality gates for AI-assisted software development.
Required Qualifications
• 5+ years of professional software testing or quality engineering experience.
• 3+ years of hands-on test automation development.
• Experience testing financial services, banking, credit union or other transaction-intensive applications.
• Strong proficiency with at least one modern test automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Appium.
• Programming or scripting experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, C#, or Python.
• Strong API testing skills using tools such as Postman, REST Assured or equivalent.
• Experience testing REST APIs, authentication, authorization and system integrations.
• Experience with SQL, data validation, and troubleshooting integration issues.
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
• Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, defect management and risk-based testing.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate directly with client stakeholders.
Highly Desirable Experience
• Direct experience with Canadian credit unions or digital banking transformation programs.
• Testing digital banking platforms such as VeriPark, Backbase, Central 1 Forge/MemberDirect, Intellect Design, Temenos, Lumin or eBankIT.
• Integration testing with core banking systems, especially Fiserv DNA or CGI RFS360.
• Experience with Canadian payment capabilities, including Interac e-Transfer, bill payments, and payment processing.
• Knowledge of mortgage lending, loan origination, commercial banking or CRM workflows.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, and . NET-based enterprise environments.
• Mobile application testing across iOS and Android.
• Performance testing with JMeter, k6, or similar tools.
• Accessibility testing aligned with WCAG standards.
• Experience testing AI-generated code or implementing automated quality controls in AI-assisted development environments.
• Experience supporting banking platform migration, cutover or production hypercare.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you will be expected to:
• Understand the client's digital banking architecture, critical workflows and integration dependencies.
• Establish or improve automated regression coverage for high-priority banking journeys.
• Identify gaps in test coverage and recommend practical improvements.
• Contribute to reliable release-readiness reporting and defect management.
• Reduce manual regression effort while improving confidence in production releases.
Why Join Aequilibrium?
• Work on meaningful digital banking modernization projects with Canadian credit unions.
• Collaborate with experienced engineers, designers, architects, and banking specialists.
• Contribute to complex integration, automation, and member-experience challenges.
• Help shape modern quality engineering practices, including AI-assisted development and testing.
• Join a remote-first Canadian team focused on purposeful impact and technical excellence.

• Contribute to automated testing and internal QA tools where appropriate.
• Work closely with production and QA leadership to prioritise defects against development milestones and release requirements.

About the role

Onfleet is hiring two senior SDETs to shape how our engineering teams build and trust automated quality. At Onfleet, the team that builds a feature owns its quality. We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Generating code is the easy part. Knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. The engineers who thrive here are scrutinizing and questioning: they reject AI slop and catch the wrong call before it ships.

Every engineer helps improve how we work instead of only following it. For this role that means building and improving the agentic tooling itself: test generation, review, verification, and the workflows around them.

<li>
Own the quality gates in CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery). Pipelines, checks, and gates, so standards are enforced by the system and not by people.
<li>
Build agentic quality tooling. Extend the agents and workflows we use for test design, review, and verification.
<li>
Raise the bar through teams. Pair on test design, review code, help make hard-to-reach code testable, and write things down so the practice outlives any one person.
<li>
Ask the testability question early. In planning, ask how we'll test it and how we'll know it broke in production.
<li>

About AllShore Talent

We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

About the Role

Adobe Workflows, API Integration and Digital Media

AllShore Tallent is seeking a mid-to-senior QA Engineer specializing in creative automation to validate end-to-end creative automation and digital media production workflows. The role spans Airtable intake and status control, AWS orchestration, Adobe Photoshop APIs, and review and approval. The current use case focuses on static banners and Photoshop outputs, with motion graphics and video workflows in the pipeline, including one moving into implementation.

The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to tracing distributed workflows, finding edge cases, maintaining state integrity, and verifying data isolation, with a background in digital media workflow engineering, ad-tech production pipelines, creative automation, or cloud-native integration QA.

Key responsibilities

· Validate asynchronous, event-driven pipelines in which intake actions trigger background state machines and webhooks. Trace the complete flow from Airtable through AWS and Photoshop APIs to Frame.io.

· Verify idempotency, de-duplication, race-condition handling, and queue throttling, including duplicate Frame.io Approved webhooks.

· Test recovery from network interruptions, expired tokens, corrupt or oversized source media, missing manifest keys, and simulated API service limits. Verify circuit breaker thresholds, queue pausing, slot release, and manual or administrator recovery.

· Design deterministic cache lifecycle tests that distinguish reusable asset-level caches (Creative/DMC) from isolated template-level manifests. Confirm that template timestamp changes and asset re-uploads invalidate caches correctly and prevent stale file delivery.

· Reconcile assets, folders, and version stacks. Test URL-encoded filenames, duplicate same-name folder structures, version stack collisions, and protection of active in-progress uploads from deletion.

· Validate AI cropping and graphical transformations across human and non-human subjects in landscape and portrait source files. Assess bounding-box and focal-point detection, identify unnecessary Firefly Generative Expand versus appropriate native cropping, and verify masks preserve native boundaries.

· Inspect typography, font substitutions, leading, multi-line wrapping, bold ranges, safe-zone margins, CTA button bounds, disclaimer visibility, and ratings bug placement across aspect ratios.

· Document reproducible, step-level defects in Jira Cloud with complete asset and log context, and evaluate results against acceptance criteria associated with Epics, Stories, and Bugs.

Requirements

Required qualifications and technical skills

• QA experience: Mid-to-senior QA engineering experience aligned with digital media workflow engineering, ad-tech production pipelines, creative automation, or cloud-native integration QA. Strong end-to-end troubleshooting, edge-case testing, state integrity, and data isolation skills.

• Airtable: Practical understanding of field types, formulas, automations, and trigger actions. Ability to validate Action = Execute and Automation Status transitions from Pending to Queued to In Progress to Review, Approved, or Finalizing. Experience checking field hygiene, null and fallback values such as NA, Automation Version Stack ID tracking, and Invalidate Asset Cache and Creative Allocation overrides

• : Strong practical knowledge of as an automated review and approval surface, including version stacking, Approved asset status hooks, share-link generation, and structural validation. Experience with API authentication nuances, including server-to-server (S2S) authentication and workarounds, custom headers, and rate-limiting behavior.

• Adobe Photoshop and imaging APIs: Solid conceptual understanding of artboards, smart objects, layer hierarchies and masks, text layers, typography leading and sizing, and bounds calculation. Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop APIs and smart-object replacement mechanics. Ability to inspect and validate PSD/PSB, JPG, PNG, and GIF outputs, including raster and animated renditions as applicable.

• AWS orchestration and observability: Comfort navigating SQS queues, DynamoDB locking and slot tracking, Step Functions / state machines, Lambda, and S3 asset storage and overwrite behavior. Ability to trace execution logs, correlation IDs, and failure payloads to distinguish upstream intake errors, service timeouts, and circuit breaker trip states.

Overview:

FinteqHub is expanding the team and is looking for an experienced QA Tech Lead to help strengthen test coverage and develop its testing approach.

About Product:

Finteqhub

А PCI DSS certified payment gateway for online businesses, providing integration with payment systems via a single software platform.
Learn more

Purpose of the role:

FinteqHub is looking for a QA Tech Lead to shape how our engineering teams approach testing and to help them make good testing decisions on their own. You'll be based in the Payment Integrations team. There you'll drive the migration of our API tests from Java to Go and Gonkey, and from there you'll develop QA practice across all teams.

Our stack: Go, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes. Tests are written in Go, Gonkey (YAML), TypeScript and Playwright, with reporting in ReportPortal and mobile testing on BrowserStack.

Key responsibilities:
• Audit the legacy Java API test suite and decide what to keep, what to retire, and what should move to a lower test level.
• Oversee the AI-assisted migration of tests to Go and Gonkey, and make sure no critical checks are lost.
• Close coverage gaps in line with the test pyramid, starting with scenarios where money is at risk.
• Help every team define and document its own test strategy and pyramid, and review them.
• Advise team leads and automation engineers on testing decisions, with a clear view of the risk and cost of each option.
• Own regression: plan the runs, distribute the checks and report status. Keep daily and nightly runs healthy: tackle flaky tests, and make sure every failure has an owner and a deadline.
• Lead the investigation of cross-team defects: bring the right people together, find where the problem is and get it reproduced.
• Set shared QA standards and tooling: ReportPortal, TMS, and formats for test cases and bug reports.
• Bring AI into everyday testing: agents write tests, engineers review them.
• Run a biweekly QA sync, mentor engineers, and help manual QAs move into automation.
• Expand UI test automation as the next stage.
Required Experience:
• Senior or Lead-level experience in test automation, with a strong focus on API testing.
• You have built a test strategy and test pyramid from scratch, in more than one product.
• A track record of changing testing practices across several teams.
• Strong test design skills: you build coverage from requirements and specs, not just automate existing cases.
• You see the system as a whole and understand the product, not just the framework.
• You know where a unit test is enough and where e2e is needed.
• Ability to align teams and drive decisions without formal authority.
• Mentoring experience.
• Experience writing tests in several languages and frameworks, and you pick up new tools quickly.
• You read Java well enough to audit and migrate an existing test suite.
• Solid understanding of REST/HTTP, JSON and API contract testing.
• Hands-on experience with k8s, Docker, PostgreSQL and any message broker.
• Experience with CI pipelines, investigating failures across services through logs, metrics and the DB, and stabilising flaky tests.
• You use AI in your daily QA work: generating tests from specs, porting tests between languages, analysing failures, reviewing code.
• You also know where AI gets things wrong.
• At least Intermediate level of English.
• Native-level Russian.
Nice to have:
• Go (a strong plus).
• Experience with TypeScript and Playwright.
• Experience migrating a test suite from one stack to another.
• Experience building AI-based tooling or agents for QA tasks.
• Mobile testing experience, including BrowserStack.
• Experience in fintech or payment systems (payment flows, callbacks, idempotency, reconciliation).
• Experience with API testing tools.

In short

We're looking for an experienced QA Lead to take ownership of quality assurance across our mobile and IoT projects. You'll design test strategies, raise the bar on QA practices, build up the chapter, and mentor a team of testers who already know what they're doing. This is a permanent role: B2B contract, monthly salary, full benefits, and you'd be reporting to the CTO on QA direction across the company.

Why intent?

We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008. Wearables, smart audio, health-tech hardware for clients like Oura and BOSE, backed by investors like a16z and Founders Fund. We're 60+ people, fully remote, and AI-native since before LinkedIn influencers discovered the term. QA here isn't ""click through the screens"": it's mobile apps talking to firmware over BLE, sensor pipelines, edge cases that only appear at -10°C with a flat battery. The bugs are real, the stakes are real, and good QA leadership changes whether a product ships well or limps out the door.

Who this role is NOT for

If your version of QA leadership is reviewing test cases and writing weekly reports, this isn't going to work. We're not hiring someone to manage a team that already runs itself. We're hiring someone who shapes how testing is done across mobile and IoT projects, decides what tooling we invest in, and pushes the whole chapter forward. If you need full specs to make a call, if ""that's not in scope"" is a sentence you use often, or if you'd rather not be the one explaining quality trade-offs to a US client at 18:30, we're probably not your people. We're AI-native and we expect you to treat AI as a daily multiplier, not a gimmick.

What you'll do
• Plan, design, and execute comprehensive testing strategies for IoT and mobile products
• Lead and mentor the QA team: guide test design, review approaches, run knowledge-sharing
• Introduce modern QA tools and practices, including test automation and CI/CD integration
• Define and track quality metrics, and continuously improve testing efficiency
• Work directly with the CTO on QA direction across the company
• Collaborate with developers, PMs, and clients to define acceptance criteria and coverage
• Oversee the full range of testing: compatibility, functional, integration, E2E, automated, performance, security, regression
• Run quality work end to end: from raw BLE signal capture all the way to cloud data validation
• Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as a party trick

How we work

Fully remote. We have a pet-friendly office in Warsaw and a coworking space in Gdansk if walls and coffee machines motivate you, but nobody will ask why you're not there. Working hours are flexible: most of the team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) are part of the rhythm, sometimes a couple of times a week, always planned ahead. You'll lead the QA chapter for the whole company, and at the same time be embedded in a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery.

What you'll get
• 20,500-28,000 PLN/month net B2B, depending on your experience
• 26 days of paid leave
• 10 days of paid sick leave
• Saltus medical care
• Self-development budget (2,000 PLN/year)
• Truly flexible hours: you organize your day
• Fully remote, with pet-friendly Warsaw office + Gdansk cowork if you want them
• All necessary equipment provided
• Internal knowledge-sharing: tech talks, team sessions, library and conference budgets

Your first months

We aim to give you space to ramp up before owning the chapter direction, but this is a real company with real deadlines: if a project needs you sooner, we'll make sure you have the support to hit the ground running. You'll get paired with a buddy, meet the team, and start with real tasks while being guided by leadership. Monthly HR check-ins, real feedback after month two, and a proper review after month three. No one waits three months to tell you something isn't working: if it's great, you'll know
column2:
if something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.

The Quality Assurance System Tester will support a large-scale agile software development program for the GrantSolutions contract, including both new software capabilities and ongoing support for legacy system functionality. We are seeking a Quality Assurance System Tester with strong software testing, test automation, and application validation experience to support the GrantSolutions software delivery environment. This role will work directly with developers, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, integration engineers, data teams, DevSecOps engineers, vendors, and Federal stakeholders to verify that new software capabilities and supported legacy functionality are reliable, secure, accessible, data-consistent, and ready for incremental release.

The Quality Assurance System Tester will participate across the SDLC by reviewing user stories and technical designs, developing test scenarios, validating software behavior, supporting application and data testing, documenting and retesting defects, and contributing to automated regression testing within CI/CD pipelines. This individual will help strengthen engineering quality, improve release confidence, and reduce production risk across new application components, existing legacy functionality, and system integrations.

• Collaborate closely with developers during sprint execution to reproduce defects, analyze logs or test results, validate fixes, clarify expected software behavior, and support code promotion and release readiness decisions.
